name: Product recall customer contact plan
summary: Once your business has issued a recall, the customer care lead gets the contact plan: affected customers from the order export, the approved notice word for word, drafts that offer only the remedies you run, and a tracker that counts a customer done only when the item is back or repaired.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for prepared work: the business's own approved record as the only authority, every unclear case written as a question for a named role, and a person who approves, contacts and records.

sources.contribution: The recall phoning method this template adapts from automated calls to a contact plan worked by people: relay only signed-off wording and the remedies the business runs; answer only from cleared answers and pass the rest to a person; no hazard advice or comfort; confirm the customer before naming the purchase; nothing about the product on a voicemail; no payment details; record what became of the item; separate a plain no-answer from a call needing a person; and never count a contact as a finished recall, with each measure on its own base. The boundary notes and worked outcomes behind these ideas are in the same package, references/safety.md and references/examples.md, same repository, commit and licence.
